thread:
maria-support: FYI customer (ACME) reports p99 spike only on streaming endpoints. non-streaming looks fine. copying logs below :thinking:

jon-eng: Can you paste request_id and sample timestamps?

maria-support: request_id=recQx7, client path: EU->edge->proxy->runtime

ops-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T12:03Z to runtime-prod-3 completed

sarah-platform: Do we have recent kernel change or batching heuristic tweak?

jon-eng: No kernel change. We did change chunk coalesce window from 8ms to 12ms last week.

ryan-sre: Can we reproduce with curl? customer said Node SDK streaming vs REST identical earlier.

maria-support: Repro steps I used:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx","prompt":"ping","stream":true}'
```
I saw first chunk at 320ms, non-streaming total 180ms.

jon-eng: Hmm. Share full tcpdump/edge logs for recQx7

maria-support: Pasted logs: "edge:conn=eu-12 req=recQx7 first_chunk=0.320s total=1.12s flushes=2 coalesce_ms=12"

sarah-platform: That coalesce_ms matches our change. Could cause TTFB regression on short outputs.

jon-eng: Proposed mitigations: 1) short-path bypass for responses < 200 tokens (force flush after first token), 2) rollback coalesce to 6ms for EU region, 3) allow customer to disable streaming and fall back to sync.

devex: We should add quick repro notebook and a sample SDK flag `stream.flush_immediate=true` so customers can workaround.

ryan-sre: For now, ops can rollback coalesce to 6ms for eu-12. I'll open runbook.

maria-support: Customer agreed to try non-stream fallback but wants a permanent fix.

jon-eng: I'll run A/B on eu-12 with 6ms and monitor p95/p99 for next 6h. tagging @sarah-platform for rollout plan.

sarah-platform: Acknowledged. I'll schedule canary and add throttle for rollout. :eyes:

maria-support: Thanks team, I told customer we'll update in <=6h.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-452 streaming-ttfb-eu-12

customer-jess: Thanks for quick response, will test once you flip it.
